'''R5-J1''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] who worked in the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] maintenance shop in [[the Retreat]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Retreat was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], created by the surviving crew members of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']], which crashed on to the planet while trying to escape [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. R5 aided [[Rewna]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] survivor in charge, while in the shop as much as possible, although its usefulness was limited by the fact it often broke down due to excessive wear.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
R5-J1 first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'' an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. It was included as a character that players could potentially meet with while exploring the Retreat.
